# Ludlow Village municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 13; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Village of Ludlow, official results of the March 24, 2026 village meeting (scanned return on the Town of Ludlow website): Newton J. Rose was elected Moderator (108 votes); the village ballot has carried a Moderator in 2024, 2025, and 2026 although 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 235 section 21 does not list the office, and the post is created on the ballot's authority
Village of Ludlow, official results of the March 25, 2025 village meeting: Newton J. Rose was elected Moderator (51 votes)
Village of Ludlow, official results of the March 26, 2024 village meeting: Newton J. Rose was elected Moderator (49 votes)
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 235 (Village of Ludlow): section 21: three Trustees are chosen by ballot for three-year terms

Village of Ludlow, official results of the March 24, 2026 village meeting (scanned return on the Town of Ludlow website): Justin Hyjek was elected Trustee for a three-year term (102 votes). Article 1 of the same ballot, the plan of merger of the Village into the Town, passed 95-17; the merger still requires legislative approval, the village remains on the Secretary of State's incorporated-villages list, and it is modeled as it stands
Village of Ludlow, official results of the March 25, 2025 village meeting: Robert Brandt was elected Trustee for a three-year term (54 votes)
Village of Ludlow, official results of the March 26, 2024 village meeting: Julie G. Nicoll was elected Trustee for a three-year term (48 votes)
